thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning a config-only deploy in the 22:00-23:00 PT change window. Canary at 5% for 30m then gradual ramp if healthy.

maria: TL;DR changes:
• routing weights: prefer eu-region for low-latency routes
• batching: default batch_window -> 8ms
• timeouts: per-request timeout -> 3s (was 4s)
• soft rate cap: 200 rps per-route

maria: Deploy spec snippet:
```yaml
deploy: config-only
canary: 0.05
batching:
  default_batch_window_ms: 8
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 3000
routing:
  prefer: eu-region
rate_limits:
  soft_per_route_rps: 200
pin: routing-policy-v3
```

alex: quick q — is model pinning required? or just routing-policy pin?

maria: just routing-policy pin. we don't touch model versions. pin = `routing-policy-v3` so traffic stays on the known variant.

alex: ok. good. what metrics should we watch for rollback threshold?

jin: watch 95p latency (+20% from baseline), error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m, and KV-cache misses rising by >30%.

sre-oncall: add: if tails (p99) > 2x baseline or 502 spike >0.3% for 5m, abort canary and pinback.

product-lead: can we get a short release note blurb for the public changelog? keep it user-friendly.

maria: release notes draft:
"Routing and batching optimizations to reduce average latency for EU customers. Minor timeout adjustment to improve tail stability. No model changes."

sre-oncall: flagging manual guard — if 502 > 0.3% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets we rollback immediate.
